title.en: The World Is a Small Village

intro.en: Ahmad and Mahmoud talk about the computer, e-mail and the internet. Notice how the computer lets us send letters anywhere in the world.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Ahmad aur Mahmoud computer, e-mail aur internet ke baare mein baat karte hain. Dekhein ke computer se hum duniya mein kahin bhi khat bhej sakte hain.
intro.ar: أَحْمَدُ وَمَحْمودٌ يَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ الحاسوبِ وَالبَريدِ الإِلِكْتْرونِيِّ وَالشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ. اِنْتَبِهْ كَيْفَ يَسْمَحُ الحاسوبُ بِإِرْسالِ الرَّسائِلِ إِلى أَيِّ مَكانٍ في العالَمِ.

dialogue.ar: كُنْتَ تَقْضي وَقْتاً طَويلاً أَمامَ التِّلْفازِ، وَالآنَ تَقْضي وَقْتاً أَطْوَلَ أَمامَ الحاسوبِ. ما سَبَبُ ذلِك؟
dialogue.tr: kunta taqḍī waqtan ṭawīlan amāma t-tilfāz, wal-āna taqḍī waqtan aṭwala amāma l-ḥāsūb. mā sababu dhālik?
dialogue.en: You used to spend a long time in front of the TV, and now you spend even longer in front of the computer. Why is that?
dialogue.ur: Aap pehle TV ke saamne bahut waqt guzarte the, ab computer ke saamne aur bhi zyada waqt guzarte hain. Iski wajah kya hai?

dialogue.ar: السَّبَبُ أَنَّ فَوائِدَ الحاسوبِ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ فَوائِدِ التِّلْفازِ.
dialogue.tr: as-sababu anna fawāʾida l-ḥāsūbi akthar min fawāʾidi t-tilfāz
dialogue.en: The reason is that the benefits of the computer are more than those of the TV.
dialogue.ur: Wajah yeh hai ke computer ke fawaid TV ke fawaid se zyada hain.

dialogue.ar: أَرى رَسائِلَ عَلى شاشَةِ الحاسوبِ.
dialogue.tr: arā rasāʾila ʿalā shāshati l-ḥāsūb
dialogue.en: I see messages on the computer screen.
dialogue.ur: Main computer ki screen par paighamaat dekh raha hoon.

dialogue.ar: هذا هُوَ البَريدُ الإلِكْتْرونِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā huwa l-barīdu l-iliktrūnī
dialogue.en: This is the e-mail.
dialogue.ur: Yeh e-mail hai.

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً، كَيْفَ تَصِلُ الرَّسائِلُ بِالبَريدِ الإلِكْتْرونِيِّ؟
dialogue.tr: ʿafwan, kayfa taṣilu r-rasāʾilu bil-barīdi l-iliktrūnī?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how do messages arrive by e-mail?
dialogue.ur: Maaf kijiye, e-mail se paighamaat kaise pahunchte hain?

dialogue.ar: هذِهِ عَناوينُ أَصْحابي المُشْتَرِكينَ في البَريدِ الإلِكْتْرونِيِّ. أَسْتَطيعُ أَنْ أَبْعَثَ رَسائِلي إِلى أَيِّ مَكانٍ في العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi ʿanāwīnu aṣḥābī l-mushtarikīn fil-barīdi l-iliktrūnī. astaṭīʿu an abʿatha rasāʾilī ilā ayyi makānin fil-ʿālam
dialogue.en: These are the addresses of my friends who use e-mail. I can send my messages to any place in the world.
dialogue.ur: Yeh mere un doston ke pate hain jo e-mail istemal karte hain. Main apne khat duniya ki kisi bhi jagah bhej sakta hoon.

dialogue.ar: هذا أَمْرٌ عَجيبٌ فِعْلاً!
dialogue.tr: hādhā amrun ʿajībun fiʿlan
dialogue.en: This is truly amazing!
dialogue.ur: Yeh waqai hairat angez baat hai!

dialogue.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ النّاسُ كَثيراً عَنِ الشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ. ما هذِهِ الشَّبَكَةُ الدَّوْلِيَّةُ؟
dialogue.tr: yataḥaddathu n-nāsu kathīran ʿani sh-shabakati d-dawliyyah. mā hādhihi sh-shabakatu d-dawliyyah?
dialogue.en: People talk a lot about the international network. What is it?
dialogue.ur: Log internet ke baare mein bahut baat karte hain. Yeh internet kya hai?

dialogue.ar: الشَّبَكَةُ الدَّوْلِيَّةُ تَرْبِطُ مَلايينَ الحَواسيبِ عَنْ طَريقِ الهاتِفِ.
dialogue.tr: ash-shabakatu d-dawliyyatu tarbiṭu malāyīna l-ḥawāsīb ʿan ṭarīqi l-hātif
dialogue.en: The international network links millions of computers through the telephone.
dialogue.ur: Internet telephone ke zariye karoron computers ko aapas mein jorta hai.

dialogue.ar: ما فائِدَةُ الشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā fāʾidatu sh-shabakati d-dawliyyah?
dialogue.en: What is the benefit of the international network?
dialogue.ur: Internet ka kya fayda hai?

dialogue.ar: فَوائِدُها كَثيرَةٌ: اُنْظُرْ، هذِهِ عَناوينُ الجامِعاتِ وَالمَكْتَباتِ وَمَراكِزِ البُحوثِ. تَسْتَطيعُ الحُصولَ عَلى المَعْلوماتِ الَّتي تُريدُها، وَأَنْتَ في بَيْتِكَ، أَوْ في مَكْتَبِكَ.
dialogue.tr: fawāʾiduhā kathīrah: unẓur, hādhihi ʿanāwīnu l-jāmiʿāti wal-maktabāti wa marākizi l-buḥūth. tastaṭīʿu l-ḥuṣūla ʿalā l-maʿlūmāti llatī turīduhā, wa anta fī baytika aw fī maktabik
dialogue.en: Its benefits are many. Look, these are the addresses of universities, libraries and research centres. You can get the information you want while you are at home or in your office.
dialogue.ur: Iske fawaid bahut hain. Dekhein, yeh jamiaat, kutub-khanon aur tehqeeqi markazon ke pate hain. Aap ghar ya daftar mein baithe jo maloomat chahein hasil kar sakte hain.

dialogue.ar: يا لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرٍ عَجيبٍ!
dialogue.tr: yā lahu min amrin ʿajīb
dialogue.en: What an amazing thing!
dialogue.ur: Kya hairat angez cheez hai!

q.en: Why does Ahmad spend more time at the computer?
q.ur: Ahmad computer par zyada waqt kyun guzarta hai?
q.ar: لِماذا يَقْضي أَحْمَدُ وَقْتاً أَطْوَلَ أَمامَ الحاسوبِ؟

options: Its benefits are more than the TV's
It is cheaper than a TV
options_ar: لِأَنَّ فَوائِدَهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ فَوائِدِ التِّلْفازِ

q.en: What does the international network link?
q.ur: Internet kis cheez ko aapas mein jorta hai?

title.en: Sounds: the Lam in the name Allah

intro.en: The letter lam in «الله» is sometimes light (مُرَقَّقَة) and sometimes heavy (مُفَخَّمَة). It is light when the word before it ends with a kasra; otherwise it is heavy. Listen and repeat the examples.
intro.ur: Lafz «الله» ka laam kabhi halka (مُرَقَّقَة) aur kabhi bhaari (مُفَخَّمَة) parha jata hai. Agar us se pehle kasra ho to halka, warna bhaari. Misalon ko sunein aur dohrayein.
intro.ar: لامُ لَفْظِ الجَلالَةِ «الله» تَكونُ أَحْياناً مُرَقَّقَةً وَأَحْياناً مُفَخَّمَةً. تُرَقَّقُ إِذا سَبَقَتْها كَسْرَةٌ، وَتُفَخَّمُ في غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ. اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرِ الأَمْثِلَةَ.

dialogue.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحيمِ.
dialogue.tr: bismi llāhi r-raḥmāni r-raḥīm
dialogue.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. (light lam, after a kasra)
dialogue.ur: Allah ke naam se, jo bahut meherban, nihayat raham karne wala hai. (kasra ke baad halka laam)

dialogue.ar: وَاللهُ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.
dialogue.tr: wallāhu ghafūrun raḥīm
dialogue.en: And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. (heavy lam)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah bakhshne wala, raham karne wala hai. (bhaari laam)

dialogue.ar: إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: If Allah wills. (heavy lam)
dialogue.ur: Agar Allah chahe. (bhaari laam)

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah. (light lam)
dialogue.ur: Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai. (halka laam)

dialogue.ar: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: jazāka llāhu khayran
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you with good. (heavy lam)
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko jaza-e-khair de. (bhaari laam)

q.en: When is the lam in «الله» light (مُرَقَّقَة)?
q.ur: «الله» ka laam kab halka (مُرَقَّقَة) hota hai?
q.ar: مَتى تُرَقَّقُ اللّامُ في لَفْظِ الجَلالَةِ «الله»؟

options: When a kasra comes before it
When a fatha comes before it
When a damma comes before it

title.en: Grammar: the form of the command verb

intro.en: The command verb (فِعْلُ الأَمْرِ) never changes its ending the way nouns do; it is fixed (مَبْنِيّ). It ends in sukun or fatha, or it drops the weak letter or the noon. Example: «اِرْكَبْ» (ride!) for a man, «اِرْكَبي» for a woman.
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-amr (hukm ka fe'l) ka aakhir badalta nahin, woh mabni (tay-shuda) rehta hai. Woh sukoon ya fatha par khatam hota hai, ya harf-e-illat ya noon gira diya jata hai. Misal: «اِرْكَبْ» (sawaar ho) mard ke liye, «اِرْكَبي» aurat ke liye.
intro.ar: فِعْلُ الأَمْرِ مَبْنِيٌّ لا يَتَغَيَّرُ آخِرُهُ كَالأَسْماءِ: يُبْنى عَلى السُّكونِ أَوِ الفَتْحِ أَوْ حَذْفِ حَرْفِ العِلَّةِ أَوِ النّونِ. مِثالٌ: اِرْكَبْ لِلرَّجُلِ، وَاِرْكَبي لِلْمَرْأَةِ.

options_ar: مُعْرَبٌ يَتَغَيَّرُ آخِرُهُ في كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ

q.en: Which is the command for a group of men?
q.ur: Mardon ki jama'at ke liye hukm kaun sa hai?
q.ar: ما فِعْلُ الأَمْرِ المُوَجَّهُ إِلى جَماعَةِ الرِّجالِ؟

title.en: Listening and speaking: TV and computer

intro.en: Listen to a conversation about daily life today, then answer questions. Then practise asking a classmate about TV and the computer.
intro.ur: Aaj ki zindagi ke baare mein ek guftagu sunein aur sawalon ke jawab dein. Phir apne saathi se TV aur computer ke baare mein sawal poochhein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنِ الحَياةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ في هَذا العَصْرِ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. بَعْدَها اِسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنِ التِّلْفازِ وَالحاسوبِ.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ لَدَيْكَ تِلْفازٌ؟
dialogue.tr: hal ladayka tilfāz?
dialogue.en: Do you have a television?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ke paas TV hai?

dialogue.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً تَجْلِسُ أَمامَ التِّلْفازِ في اليَوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: kam sāʿatan tajlisu amāma t-tilfāzi fil-yawm?
dialogue.en: How many hours a day do you sit in front of the TV?
dialogue.ur: Aap din mein kitne ghante TV ke saamne baithte hain?

dialogue.ar: ماذا تُشاهِدُ في التِّلْفازِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā tushāhidu fit-tilfāz?
dialogue.en: What do you watch on TV?
dialogue.ur: Aap TV par kya dekhte hain?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ لَدَيْكَ حاسوبٌ؟
dialogue.tr: hal ladayka ḥāsūb?
dialogue.en: Do you have a computer?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ke paas computer hai?

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَسْتَخْدِمُ الحاسوبَ؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā tastakhdimu l-ḥāsūb?
dialogue.en: Why do you use the computer?
dialogue.ur: Aap computer kyun istemal karte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَيُّهُما أَفْضَلُ في رَأْيِكَ: التِّلْفازُ أَمِ الحاسوبُ؟ وَلِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: ayyuhumā afḍalu fī raʾyik: at-tilfāzu am al-ḥāsūb? wa limādhā?
dialogue.en: Which is better in your opinion: the TV or the computer? And why?
dialogue.ur: Aap ki raaye mein kaun behtar hai: TV ya computer? Aur kyun?

q.en: How do you ask «Do you have a computer?»
q.ur: «Kya aap ke paas computer hai?» kaise poochenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ صَديقَكَ إِنْ كانَ عِنْدَهُ حاسوبٌ؟

title.en: Transport and communication, old and new
title.ur: Naql o hamal aur rabte ke zaraye: purane aur naye

intro.en: A reading passage about why the world has become a small village: modern transport and modern communication. It compares old camels and doves with cars, planes, the telephone and the internet.
intro.ur: Is paaray mein bataya gaya hai ke duniya chhota gaon kyun ban gayi: jadeed sawari aur jadeed rabte ke zaraye. Purane unt aur kabootar ka muqabla car, jahaz, telephone aur internet se kiya gaya hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ سَبَبِ تَحَوُّلِ العالَمِ إِلى قَرْيَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ: وَسائِلُ النَّقْلِ الحَديثَةُ وَوَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةُ. يُقارِنُ النَّصُّ بَيْنَ الجِمالِ وَالحَمامِ قَديماً وَالسَّيّاراتِ وَالطّائِراتِ وَالهاتِفِ وَالإِنْتَرْنِتِ حَديثاً.

dialogue.ar: يَتَكَوَّنُ العالَمُ مِنْ سِتِّ قارّاتٍ، وَيَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِهِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سِتَّةِ مِلْياراتِ إِنْسانٍ.
dialogue.tr: yatakawwanu l-ʿālamu min sitti qārrāt, wa yablughu ʿadadu sukkānihi akthara min sittati milyārāti insān
dialogue.en: The world is made of six continents, and its population is more than six billion people.
dialogue.ur: Duniya chhe barr-e-azam par mushtamil hai aur is ki abadi chhe arab se zyada insan hai.

dialogue.ar: هذا العالَمُ الواسِعُ أَصْبَحَ قَرْيَةً صَغيرَةً. كَيْفَ صارَ ذلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hādha l-ʿālamu l-wāsiʿu aṣbaḥa qaryatan ṣaghīrah. kayfa ṣāra dhālik?
dialogue.en: This wide world has become a small village. How did that happen?
dialogue.ur: Yeh wasi duniya ek chhota gaon ban gayi hai. Yeh kaise hua?

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ سَبَبانِ، أَوَّلُهُما: وَسائِلُ النَّقْلِ الحَديثَةِ، وَثانيهِما: وَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةِ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka sababān, awwaluhumā: wasāʾilu n-naqli l-ḥadīthah, wa thānīhimā: wasāʾilu l-ittiṣāli l-ḥadīthah
dialogue.en: There are two reasons: the first is modern means of transport, and the second is modern means of communication.
dialogue.ur: Do wajahein hain: pehli jadeed sawariyan aur doosri jadeed rabte ke zaraye.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ وَسائِلُ النَّقْلِ في العُصورِ القَديمَةِ بَطيئَةً جِدّاً، وَكانَ النّاسُ يُسافِرونَ مَشْياً عَلى الأَقْدامِ.
dialogue.tr: kānat wasāʾilu n-naqli fil-ʿuṣūri l-qadīmati baṭīʾatan jiddan, wa kāna n-nāsu yusāfirūna mashyan ʿalal-aqdām
dialogue.en: In ancient times means of transport were very slow, and people travelled on foot.
dialogue.ur: Purane zamanon mein sawariyan bahut sust thin aur log paidal safar karte the.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذَ النّاسُ يَسْتَعْمِلونَ الحَيَواناتِ، كَالجِمالِ وَالبِغالِ وَالحَميرِ، في نَقْلِ حاجاتِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: thumma akhadha n-nāsu yastaʿmilūna l-ḥayawānāt, kal-jimāli wal-bighāli wal-ḥamīr, fī naqli ḥājātihim
dialogue.en: Then people began to use animals, such as camels, mules and donkeys, to carry their belongings.
dialogue.ur: Phir log apna saman uthane ke liye janwar istemal karne lage, jaise unt, khachchar aur gadhe.

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ مُدَّةٍ، صَنَعَ الإِنْسانُ عَرَبَاتٍ صَغيرَةً لَها أَرْبَعُ عَجَلاتٍ، تَسيرُ دونَ مُحَرِّكٍ، ثُمَّ صُنِعَتْ بَعْدَ ذلِكَ المَراكِبُ الشِّراعِيَّةُ، الَّتي تَسيرُ عَلى الماءِ.
dialogue.tr: baʿda muddah, ṣanaʿa l-insānu ʿarabātin ṣaghīratan lahā arbaʿu ʿajalāt, tasīru dūna muḥarrik, thumma ṣuniʿat baʿda dhālika l-marākibu sh-shirāʿiyyah, allatī tasīru ʿalal-māʾ
dialogue.en: After a while, man made small carts with four wheels that moved without an engine, and later sailing ships that travel on water.
dialogue.ur: Kuch arse baad insan ne chaar pahiyon wali chhoti gaadiyan banayin jo bina engine ke chalti thin, phir baadbani kashtiyan banayin jo paani par chalti hain.

dialogue.ar: صَنَعَ الإِنْسانُ في العَصْرِ الحَديثِ مَرْكَباتٍ تَعْمَلُ بِالمُحَرِّكاتِ، فَظَهَرَ كَثيرٌ مِنْ وَسائِلِ النَّقْلِ الحَديثَةِ: مِثْلُ السَّيّاراتِ، وَالقِطاراتِ، وَالسُّفُنِ، وَالطّائِراتِ.
dialogue.tr: ṣanaʿa l-insānu fil-ʿaṣri l-ḥadīthi markabātin taʿmalu bil-muḥarrikāt, fa-ẓahara kathīrun min wasāʾili n-naqli l-ḥadīthah: mithlu s-sayyārāt, wal-qiṭārāt, was-sufun, waṭ-ṭāʾirāt
dialogue.en: In modern times man made vehicles that run on engines, so many modern means of transport appeared: cars, trains, ships and planes.
dialogue.ur: Jadeed daur mein insan ne engine se chalne wali sawariyan banayin, to bahut si jadeed sawariyan saamne aayin: car, train, jahaz aur hawai jahaz.

dialogue.ar: جَعَلَتْ هذِهِ الوَسائِلُ العالَمَ قَرْيَةً صَغيرَةً: فَالإِنْسانُ يَنْتَقِلُ في ساعاتٍ، مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلى بَلَدٍ، وَمِنْ قارَّةٍ إِلى قارَّةٍ.
dialogue.tr: jaʿalat hādhihi l-wasāʾilu l-ʿālama qaryatan ṣaghīrah: fal-insānu yantaqilu fī sāʿāt, min baladin ilā balad, wa min qārratin ilā qārrah
dialogue.en: These means made the world a small village: a person moves in hours from country to country and from continent to continent.
dialogue.ur: In zarayon ne duniya ko chhota gaon bana diya: insan chand ghanton mein ek mulk se doosre mulk aur ek barr-e-azam se doosre tak pahunch jata hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا السَّبَبُ الثّاني الَّذي جَعَلَ العالَمَ قَرْيَةً صَغيرَةً، فَهُوَ وَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةُ مِثْلُ: الصُّحُفِ، وَالهاتِفِ، وَالإِذاعَةِ، وَالتِّلْفازِ، وَالحاسوبِ، وَالشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā s-sababu th-thānī lladhī jaʿala l-ʿālama qaryatan ṣaghīrah, fahuwa wasāʾilu l-ittiṣāli l-ḥadīthah mithlu: aṣ-ṣuḥuf, wal-hātif, wal-idhāʿah, wat-tilfāz, wal-ḥāsūb, wash-shabakati d-dawliyyah
dialogue.en: The second reason that made the world a small village is modern means of communication such as newspapers, the telephone, the radio, television, the computer and the internet.
dialogue.ur: Doosri wajah jis ne duniya ko chhota gaon banaya jadeed rabte ke zaraye hain, jaise akhbarat, telephone, radio, TV, computer aur internet.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتِ الأَخْبارُ تَصِلُ بَعْدَ مُدَّةٍ طَويلَةٍ، وَقَدْ لا تَصِلُ في كَثيرٍ مِنَ الأَحْيانِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānati l-akhbāru taṣilu baʿda muddatin ṭawīlah, wa qad lā taṣilu fī kathīrin mina l-aḥyān
dialogue.en: News used to arrive after a long time, and often it might not arrive at all.
dialogue.ur: Pehle khabrein bohat der baad pahunchti thin, aur aksar to pahunchti hi nahin thin.

q.en: How many continents does the passage say the world has?
q.ur: Paare ke mutabiq duniya mein kitne barr-e-azam hain?
q.ar: كَمْ قارَّةً في العالَمِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What are the two reasons the world became a small village?
q.ur: Duniya ke chhota gaon banne ki do wajahein kya hain?
q.ar: ما سَبَبا تَحَوُّلِ العالَمِ إِلى قَرْيَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ؟

options_ar: وَسائِلُ النَّقْلِ الحَديثَةُ وَوَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةُ

q.en: Which one is an animal used for carrying in old times?
q.ur: Purane zamane mein saman uthane wala janwar kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيٌّ مِمّا يَأْتي حَيَوانٌ كانَ يُسْتَعْمَلُ لِلنَّقْلِ قَديماً؟

options_ar: جِهازٌ نَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ مَعَ مَنْ يَبْعُدُ عَنّا

title.en: Grammar: the form of the past verb

intro.en: The past verb is also fixed (مَبْنِيّ). It ends in damma when «واو الجماعة» is added (صَنَعوا), in sukun when «تاء الفاعل», «نا» or «نون النسوة» is added (جَلَسْتُ), and in fatha in all other cases (صَنَعَ).
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-maazi bhi mabni hota hai. Agar «waaw-e-jama'at» lage to damma par (صَنَعوا), agar «taa-e-faa'il», «naa» ya «noon-e-niswa» lage to sukoon par (جَلَسْتُ), aur baaqi sab surtoon mein fatha par (صَنَعَ) mabni hota hai.
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ الماضي مَبْنِيٌّ أَيْضاً: يُبْنى عَلى الضَّمِّ مَعَ واوِ الجَماعَةِ (صَنَعوا)، وَعَلى السُّكونِ مَعَ تاءِ الفاعِلِ أَوْ «نا» أَوْ نونِ النِّسْوَةِ (جَلَسْتُ)، وَعَلى الفَتْحِ في غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ (صَنَعَ).

dialogue.ar: صَنَعوا المَراكِبَ.
dialogue.tr: ṣanaʿū l-marākib
dialogue.en: They made the ships. (ends in damma: waw of the group)
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kashtiyan banayin. (damma, waaw-e-jama'at ki wajah se)

dialogue.ar: جَلَسْتُ هُنا.
dialogue.tr: jalastu hunā
dialogue.en: I sat here. (ends in sukun: ta of the doer)
dialogue.ur: Main yahan baitha. (sukoon, taa-e-faa'il ki wajah se)

dialogue.ar: كَتَبْنا الدَّرْسَ.
dialogue.tr: katabnā d-dars
dialogue.en: We wrote the lesson. (ends in sukun: «naa»)
dialogue.ur: Hum ne sabaq likha. (sukoon, «naa» ki wajah se)

dialogue.ar: البَناتُ شَكَرْنَ اللهَ.
dialogue.tr: al-banātu shakarna llāh
dialogue.en: The girls thanked Allah. (ends in sukun: noon of women)
dialogue.ur: Ladkiyon ne Allah ka shukr ada kiya. (sukoon, noon-e-niswa ki wajah se)

dialogue.ar: صَنَعَ الإِنْسانُ المَرْكَباتِ.
dialogue.tr: ṣanaʿa l-insānu l-markabāt
dialogue.en: Man made vehicles. (ends in fatha)
dialogue.ur: Insan ne sawariyan banayin. (fatha)

dialogue.ar: دَرَسا الوَسائِلَ الحَديثَةَ.
dialogue.tr: darasā l-wasāʾila l-ḥadīthah
dialogue.en: They (two) studied the modern means. (fatha: alif of the two)
dialogue.ur: Un dono ne jadeed zaraye parhe. (fatha, alif-e-tasniya ke saath)

q.en: The past verb «جَلَسْتُ» ends in sukun because of:

q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l fatha par khatam hota hai?

intro.en: Zaynab and Fatima talk about a symposium on globalization. One group supports it and one group rejects it. Notice how each side gives its reasons.
intro.ur: Zainab aur Fatima aalmgiriyat (globalization) par ek seminar ke baare mein baat karti hain. Ek giroh isse chahta hai aur doosra rad karta hai. Dekhein har taraf apni daleel kaise deti hai.
intro.ar: زَيْنَبُ وَفاطِمَةُ تَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ نَدْوَةٍ عَنِ العَوْلَمَةِ؛ فَريقٌ يُؤَيِّدُها وَفَريقٌ يَرْفُضُها. اِنْتَبِهْ كَيْفَ يَذْكُرُ كُلُّ فَريقٍ أَسْبابَهُ.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ نَدْوَةً مُفيدَةً. لِماذا لَمْ تَحْضُري؟
dialogue.tr: kānat nadwatan mufīdah. limādhā lam taḥḍurī?
dialogue.en: It was a useful symposium. Why did you not attend?
dialogue.ur: Bahut mufeed seminar tha. Aap kyun nahin aayin?

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ أَمْسِ مَشْغولَةً. زارَنا بَعْضُ الضُّيوفِ.
dialogue.tr: kuntu amsi mashghūlah. zāranā baʿḍu ḍ-ḍuyūf
dialogue.en: I was busy yesterday. Some guests visited us.
dialogue.ur: Kal main masroof thi. Kuch mehman humare ghar aaye the.

dialogue.ar: حَضَرَتِ النَّدْوَةَ مُعْظَمُ مُدَرِّساتِ الجامِعَةِ وَطالِباتِها.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍarati n-nadwata muʿẓamu mudarrisāti l-jāmiʿati wa ṭālibātihā
dialogue.en: Most of the university's teachers and students attended the symposium.
dialogue.ur: Seminar mein university ki zyadatar ustaniyan aur talibaat aayin.

dialogue.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ في النَّدْوَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā ḥadatha fin-nadwah?
dialogue.en: What happened at the symposium?
dialogue.ur: Seminar mein kya hua?

dialogue.ar: كانَتِ المُتَحَدِّثاتُ فَريقَيْنِ: فَريقاً يَدْعو إِلى العَوْلَمَةِ، وَفَريقاً يَرْفُضُ العَوْلَمَةَ.
dialogue.tr: kānati l-mutaḥaddithātu farīqayn: farīqan yadʿū ilā l-ʿawlamah, wa farīqan yarfuḍu l-ʿawlamah
dialogue.en: The speakers were two groups: one group calls for globalization and one group rejects it.
dialogue.ur: Baat karne wali do giroh thin: ek giroh aalmgiriyat ki dawat deta tha aur doosra isse rad karta tha.

dialogue.ar: وَما حُجَّةُ كُلِّ فَريقٍ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mā ḥujjatu kulli farīq?
dialogue.en: And what is the argument of each group?
dialogue.ur: Aur har giroh ki daleel kya hai?

dialogue.ar: يَقولُ الفَريقُ الأَوَّلُ: سَتُؤَدّي العَوْلَمَةُ إِلى تَنْمِيَةِ جَميعِ الدُّوَلِ، خاصَّةً الدُّوَلَ الفَقيرَةَ.
dialogue.tr: yaqūlu l-farīqu l-awwal: satu'addī l-ʿawlamatu ilā tanmiyati jamīʿi d-duwal, khāṣṣatan d-duwala l-faqīrah
dialogue.en: The first group says: globalization will lead to the development of all countries, especially poor countries.
dialogue.ur: Pehla giroh kehta hai: aalmgiriyat tamam mumalik ki taraqqi ka sabab banegi, khaas taur par gharib mumalik ki.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا يَقولُ الفَريقُ الثّاني؟
dialogue.tr: wa mādhā yaqūlu l-farīqu th-thānī?
dialogue.en: And what does the second group say?
dialogue.ur: Aur doosra giroh kya kehta hai?

dialogue.ar: يَقولُ إِنَّ العَوْلَمَةَ سَتُؤَدّي إِلى هَيْمَنَةِ الدُّوَلِ الغَنِيَّةِ عَلى الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yaqūlu inna l-ʿawlamata satu'addī ilā haymanati d-duwali l-ghaniyyati ʿalā d-duwali l-faqīrah
dialogue.en: It says globalization will lead to rich countries dominating poor countries.
dialogue.ur: Woh kehta hai ke aalmgiriyat se amir mumalik ghareeb mumalik par ghalib aa jayenge.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ انْتَهَتِ النَّدْوَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: wa kayfa intahati n-nadwah?
dialogue.en: And how did the symposium end?
dialogue.ur: Aur seminar kaise khatam hua?

dialogue.ar: دارَ نِقاشٌ ساخِنٌ بَعْدَ النَّدْوَةِ، وَرَفَضَ مُعْظَمُ الحُضورِ العَوْلَمَةَ.
dialogue.tr: dāra niqāshun sākhin baʿda n-nadwah, wa rafaḍa muʿẓamu l-ḥuḍūri l-ʿawlamah
dialogue.en: A hot discussion took place after the symposium, and most of the audience rejected globalization.
dialogue.ur: Seminar ke baad garma garam behes hui aur zyadatar hazireen ne aalmgiriyat ko rad kar diya.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā?
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.ur: Kyun?

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّ الدُّوَلَ الغَنِيَّةَ سَتَفْرِضُ لُغاتِها وَثَقافاتِها عَلى الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: li-anna d-duwala l-ghaniyyata satafriḍu lughātihā wa thaqāfātihā ʿalā d-duwali l-faqīrah
dialogue.en: Because the rich countries will impose their languages and cultures on the poor countries.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke amir mumalik apni zubanein aur saqafatein ghareeb mumalik par thop denge.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَتَّفِقُ مَعَ هذا الرَّأْيِ، أَنا أَرْفُضُ العَوْلَمَةَ.
dialogue.tr: anā attafiqu maʿa hādha r-raʾy, anā arfuḍu l-ʿawlamah
dialogue.en: I agree with this opinion; I reject globalization.
dialogue.ur: Main is raaye se muttafiq hoon, main aalmgiriyat ko rad karti hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا لَنْ أَتْرُكَ لُغَتي وَثَقافَتي.
dialogue.tr: wa anā lan atruka lughatī wa thaqāfatī
dialogue.en: And I will never leave my language and my culture.
dialogue.ur: Aur main apni zubaan aur saqafat kabhi nahin chhodungi.

q.ur: Fatima seminar mein kyun nahin gayi?

q.en: What does the second group fear?
q.ur: Doosra giroh kis baat se darta hai?

options: Rich countries will dominate poor countries
options_ar: أَنْ تَسيطِرَ الدُّوَلُ الغَنِيَّةُ عَلى الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ
ما تَتَميَّزُ بِهِ الأُمَّةُ مِنْ عاداتٍ وَعُلومٍ وَفُنونٍ

q.en: What does Zaynab say at the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein Zainab kya kehti hai?

options: She will not leave her language and culture
She will skip the next symposium

intro.en: Words change their last vowel according to their job in the sentence. The main marks are damma, fatha, kasra and sukun. Nouns take damma, fatha or kasra. Verbs take damma, fatha or sukun. Example: «الطِّفْلُ، الطِّفْلَ، الطِّفْلِ» and «يَجْلِسُ، لَنْ يَجْلِسَ، لَمْ يَجْلِسْ».
intro.ur: Alfaaz jumle mein apne kaam ke mutabiq aakhri harkat badalte hain. Asli alamaat hain: damma, fatha, kasra aur sukoon. Ism par damma, fatha ya kasra aata hai. Fe'l par damma, fatha ya sukoon. Misal: «الطِّفْلُ، الطِّفْلَ، الطِّفْلِ» aur «يَجْلِسُ، لَنْ يَجْلِسَ، لَمْ يَجْلِسْ».
intro.ar: تَتَغَيَّرُ حَرَكَةُ آخِرِ الكَلِمَةِ بِحَسَبِ مَوْقِعِها في الجُمْلَةِ. عَلاماتُ الإِعْرابِ الأَصْلِيَّةُ: الضَّمَّةُ وَالفَتْحَةُ وَالكَسْرَةُ وَالسُّكونُ. الاسْمُ يَأْخُذُ الضَّمَّةَ أَوِ الفَتْحَةَ أَوِ الكَسْرَةَ، وَالمُضارِعُ الضَّمَّةَ أَوِ الفَتْحَةَ أَوِ السُّكونَ. مِثالٌ: الطِّفْلُ، الطِّفْلَ، الطِّفْلِ، وَيَجْلِسُ، لَنْ يَجْلِسَ، لَمْ يَجْلِسْ.

q.en: Which four marks are the main case endings?
q.ur: Chaar asli alamaat kaun si hain?

q.en: In «لَمْ يَجْلِسْ» the verb ends in:
In «لَنْ يَجْلِسَ» the verb ends in:

title.en: Listening and speaking: one language, one culture?
title.ur: Sun kar samajhna aur guftagu: ek zubaan, ek saqafat?

intro.en: Listen to the dialogue about the book symposium and answer the questions. Then discuss with classmates whether the world should have one language, one culture, one economy and one politics.
intro.ur: Kitab ke seminar ki guftagu sunein aur sawalon ke jawab dein. Phir saathiyon se behes karein ke kya duniya ki ek zubaan, ek saqafat, ek maeeshat aur ek siyasat honi chahiye.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى الحِوارِ عَنْ نَدْوَةِ الكِتابِ وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. ثُمَّ ناقِشْ زُمَلاءَكَ: هَلْ يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَكونَ لِلْعالَمِ لُغَةٌ واحِدَةٌ وَثَقافَةٌ واحِدَةٌ وَاقْتِصادٌ واحِدٌ وَسِياسَةٌ واحِدَةٌ؟

dialogue.ar: فِي أَيِّ قارَّةٍ يَقَعُ بَلَدُكَ؟
dialogue.tr: fī ayyi qārratin yaqaʿu baladuk?
dialogue.en: In which continent is your country?
dialogue.ur: Aap ka mulk kis barr-e-azam mein hai?

dialogue.ar: ما أَغْنى الدُّوَلِ في العالَمِ؟ ما أَفْقَرُ الدُّوَلِ في العالَمِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā aghnā d-duwali fil-ʿālam? mā afqaru d-duwali fil-ʿālam?
dialogue.en: What are the richest countries in the world? What are the poorest?
dialogue.ur: Duniya ke sab se amir mumalik kaun se hain? Sab se ghareeb kaun se?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تُوافِقُ عَلى أَنْ تَكونَ هُناكَ ثَقافَةٌ وَلُغَةٌ واحِدَةٌ لِكُلِّ العالَمِ؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal tuwāfiqu ʿalā an takūna hunāka thaqāfatun wa lughatun wāḥidatun li-kulli l-ʿālam? limādhā?
dialogue.en: Do you agree that there should be one culture and one language for the whole world? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap is par muttafiq hain ke poori duniya ki ek saqafat aur ek zubaan ho? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تُوافِقُ عَلى تَرْكِ لُغَتِكَ وَثَقافَتِكَ؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal tuwāfiqu ʿalā tarki lughatika wa thaqāfatik? limādhā?
dialogue.en: Do you agree to leave your language and culture? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap apni zubaan aur saqafat chhodne par raazi hain? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَكونَ لِلْعالَمِ اقْتِصادٌ واحِدٌ.
dialogue.tr: yajibu an yakūna lil-ʿālami iqtiṣādun wāḥid
dialogue.en: The world must have one economy. (a topic for discussion)
dialogue.ur: Duniya ki ek maeeshat honi chahiye. (behes ka mauzu)

q.en: How do you ask «Do you agree?»
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَطْلُبُ المُوافَقَةَ عَلى رَأْيٍ؟

title.en: Countries of the North and the South

intro.en: A reading passage that compares rich countries of the north with poor countries of the south. A man invites his friend to fly over the small village of the world and see how people live.
intro.ur: Is paaray mein shimali amir mumalik aur janubi ghareeb mumalik ka muqabla hai. Ek shakhs apne dost ko hawai jahaz par duniya ke chhote gaon ki sair par bulata hai taake dekhe log kaise rehte hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ يُقارِنُ بَيْنَ دُوَلِ الشَّمالِ الغَنِيَّةِ وَدُوَلِ الجَنوبِ الفَقيرَةِ. رَجُلٌ يَدْعو صَديقَهُ لِيَطيرا فَوْقَ قَرْيَةِ العالَمِ الصَّغيرَةِ وَيَرَيا كَيْفَ يَعيشُ النّاسُ.

dialogue.ar: أَصْبَحَ العالَمُ اليَوْمَ قَرْيَةً صَغيرَةً بِسَبَبِ وَسائِلِ النَّقْلِ الحَديثَةِ، وَوَسائِلِ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةِ.
dialogue.tr: aṣbaḥa l-ʿālamu l-yawma qaryatan ṣaghīratan bi-sababi wasāʾili n-naqli l-ḥadīthah, wa wasāʾili l-ittiṣāli l-ḥadīthah
dialogue.en: Today the world has become a small village because of modern transport and modern communication.
dialogue.ur: Aaj duniya jadeed sawariyon aur jadeed rabte ke zarayon ki wajah se chhota gaon ban gayi hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنِّي أَدْعوكَ يا صاحِبي لِزِيارَةِ هذِهِ القَرْيَةِ الصَّغيرَةِ. هَيّا نَتَجَوَّلُ فيها، وَنَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ يَعيشُ سُكّانُها.
dialogue.tr: innī adʿūka yā ṣāḥibī li-ziyārati hādhihi l-qaryati ṣ-ṣaghīrah. hayyā natajawwalu fīhā, wa nanẓuru kayfa yaʿīshu sukkānuhā
dialogue.en: I invite you, my friend, to visit this small village. Come, let us tour it and see how its people live.
dialogue.ur: Mere dost, main aap ko is chhote gaon ki sair ki dawat deta hoon. Aayiye ghoomein aur dekhein yahan ke log kaise rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: إِنِّي أَمْلِكُ طائِرَةً سَريعَةً. تَفَضَّلْ يا صاحِبي، اِرْكَبِ الطّائِرَةَ، وَهَيّا بِنا نَنْطَلِقُ.
dialogue.tr: innī amliku ṭāʾiratan sarīʿah. tafaḍḍal yā ṣāḥibī, irkabi ṭ-ṭāʾirah, wa hayyā binā nanṭaliq
dialogue.en: I own a fast plane. Please, my friend, board the plane and let us set off.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas ek tez hawai jahaz hai. Tashreef laiye dost, jahaz mein sawaar hon, aur chalein.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلى هذِهِ الدُّوَلِ، إِنَّها دُوَلٌ غَنِيَّةٌ، تَمْلِكُ القُوَّةَ وَالعِلْمَ وَالمالَ.
dialogue.tr: unẓur ilā hādhihi d-duwal, innahā duwalun ghaniyyah, tamliku l-quwwata wal-ʿilma wal-māl
dialogue.en: Look at these countries: they are rich countries that have power, knowledge and money.
dialogue.ur: In mumalik ko dekhein, yeh amir mumalik hain jin ke paas taqat, ilm aur daulat hai.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلى النّاسِ، إِنَّهُمْ أَغْنِياءُ في هذِهِ الدُّوَلِ، يَلْبَسونَ أَجْمَلَ الثِّيابِ، وَهُمْ أَصِحّاءُ، وَيَعيشونَ في بُيوتٍ جَميلَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: unẓur ilā n-nās, innahum aghniyāʾu fī hādhihi d-duwal, yalbasūna ajmala th-thiyāb, wa hum aṣiḥḥāʾ, wa yaʿīshūna fī buyūtin jamīlah
dialogue.en: Look at the people: they are rich in these countries, they wear the most beautiful clothes, they are healthy, and they live in beautiful houses.
dialogue.ur: Logon ko dekhein, in mumalik mein woh amir hain, sab se khoobsurat kapde pehente hain, tandurust hain aur khoobsurat gharon mein rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: ما أَكْثَرَ المَدارِسَ وَالجامِعاتِ وَالمُسْتَشْفَياتِ وَالمَصانِعَ وَالمَزارِعَ هُنا! إِنَّهُمْ يَعيشونَ في أَمْنٍ وَرَخاءٍ.
dialogue.tr: mā akthara l-madārisa wal-jāmiʿāti wal-mustashfayāti wal-maṣāniʿa wal-mazāriʿa hunā! innahum yaʿīshūna fī amnin wa rakhāʾ
dialogue.en: How many schools, universities, hospitals, factories and farms there are here! They live in security and prosperity.
dialogue.ur: Yahan kitne madrase, jamiaat, aspatal, karkhane aur khet hain! Woh aman aur khushhali mein rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: هَيّا نَزورُ الجانِبَ الآخَرَ مِنَ العالَمِ، هذِهِ دُوَلُ الجَنوبِ. إِنَّها دُوَلٌ فَقيرَةٌ، لا تَمْلِكُ القُوَّةَ وَلا العِلْمَ وَلا المالَ.
dialogue.tr: hayyā nazūru l-jānibā l-ākhara mina l-ʿālam, hādhihi duwalu l-janūb. innahā duwalun faqīrah, lā tamliku l-quwwata wa lā l-ʿilma wa lā l-māl
dialogue.en: Come, let us visit the other side of the world: these are the countries of the south. They are poor countries that have no power, no knowledge and no money.
dialogue.ur: Aayiye duniya ke doosre kinare ko dekhein, yeh janubi mumalik hain. Yeh ghareeb mumalik hain jin ke paas na taqat hai, na ilm, na daulat.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلى هؤُلاءِ النّاسِ، إِنَّهُمْ فُقَراءُ يَلْبَسونَ ثِياباً بَسيطَةً، وَيَعيشونَ في بُيوتٍ صَغيرَةٍ، وَمُعْظَمُهُمْ مَرْضى.
dialogue.tr: unẓur ilā hāʾulāʾi n-nās, innahum fuqarāʾu yalbasūna thiyāban basīṭah, wa yaʿīshūna fī buyūtin ṣaghīrah, wa muʿẓamuhum marḍā
dialogue.en: Look at these people: they are poor, wear simple clothes, live in small houses, and most of them are sick.
dialogue.ur: In logon ko dekhein, yeh ghareeb hain, saada kapde pehente hain, chhote gharon mein rehte hain aur inme se zyadatar beemar hain.

dialogue.ar: ما أَقَلَّ المَدارِسَ وَالجامِعاتِ وَالمُسْتَشْفَياتِ وَالمَصانِعَ وَالمَزارِعَ هُنا! لِماذا يَتَقاتَلُ النّاسُ في هذِهِ البِلادِ؟ وَلِماذا يَنْتَشِرُ الفَقْرُ وَالمَرَضُ وَالجَهْلُ هُنا؟
dialogue.tr: mā aqalla l-madārisa wal-jāmiʿāti wal-mustashfayāti wal-maṣāniʿa wal-mazāriʿa hunā! limādhā yataqātalu n-nāsu fī hādhihi l-bilād? wa limādhā yantashiru l-faqru wal-maraḍu wal-jahlu hunā?
dialogue.en: How few schools, universities, hospitals, factories and farms there are here! Why do people fight in these lands? And why do poverty, sickness and ignorance spread here?
dialogue.ur: Yahan kitne kam madrase, jamiaat, aspatal, karkhane aur khet hain! In mulkon mein log aapas mein kyun ladte hain? Aur yahan gharibi, beemari aur jahalat kyun phailti hai?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ رَأَيْتَ يا صاحِبي هذِهِ القَرْيَةَ الصَّغيرَةَ؟ يَعيشُ نِصْفُ سُكّانِها في رَخاءٍ، وَيَعيشُ النِّصْفُ الآخَرُ في فَقْرٍ وَحَرْبٍ.
dialogue.tr: hal raʾayta yā ṣāḥibī hādhihi l-qaryata ṣ-ṣaghīrah? yaʿīshu niṣfu sukkānihā fī rakhāʾ, wa yaʿīshu n-niṣfu l-ākharu fī faqrin wa ḥarb
dialogue.en: My friend, have you seen this small village? Half of its people live in comfort and the other half live in poverty and war.
dialogue.ur: Dost, kya aap ne yeh chhota gaon dekha? Iske aadhe log khushhali mein aur baaqi aadhe gharibi aur jang mein rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا لا يَعيشُ جَميعُ سُكّانِ القَرْيَةِ في رَخاءٍ وَأَمْنٍ؟ هَلْ سَيَحْدُثُ ذلِكَ في يَوْمٍ مِنَ الأَيّامِ؟ اللهُ أَعْلَمُ.
dialogue.tr: limādhā lā yaʿīshu jamīʿu sukkāni l-qaryati fī rakhāʾin wa amn? hal sayaḥduthu dhālika fī yawmin mina l-ayyām? allāhu aʿlam
dialogue.en: Why do not all the people of the village live in comfort and security? Will that happen one day? Allah knows best.
dialogue.ur: Gaon ke sab log khushhali aur aman mein kyun nahin rehte? Kya kisi din aisa hoga? Allah behtar jaanta hai.

q.en: Which countries are rich in the passage?
q.ur: Paare mein kaun se mumalik amir hain?

q.en: What spreads in the countries of the south, according to the passage?
q.ur: Paare ke mutabiq janubi mumalik mein kya phailta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَنْتَشِرُ في دُوَلِ الجَنوبِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

title.en: Grammar: the case of the present verb

intro.en: The present verb is raised (damma) by default. After a nasb particle such as «أَنْ» or «لَنْ» it takes fatha. After a jazm particle such as «لَمْ» or «لا» of prohibition it takes sukun. Example: «يَقْرَأُ» then «لَنْ يَقْرَأَ» then «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ».
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-mudari' asal mein marfoo' (damma) hota hai. «أَنْ» ya «لَنْ» jaise harf-e-nasb ke baad fatha aata hai. «لَمْ» ya «لا» (nahi) jaise harf-e-jazm ke baad sukoon aata hai. Misal: «يَقْرَأُ»، phir «لَنْ يَقْرَأَ»، phir «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ».
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ مَرْفوعٌ بِالضَّمَّةِ في الأَصْلِ. وَبَعْدَ أَداةِ نَصْبٍ مِثْلِ «أَنْ» وَ«لَنْ» يَأْخُذُ فَتْحَةً، وَبَعْدَ أَداةِ جَزْمٍ مِثْلِ «لَمْ» وَ«لا» النّاهِيَةِ يَأْخُذُ سُكوناً. مِثالٌ: يَقْرَأُ، لَنْ يَقْرَأَ، لَمْ يَقْرَأْ.

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ العَرَبِيَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: urīdu an ataʿallama l-ʿarabiyyah
dialogue.en: I want to learn Arabic. (after «an»: fatha)
dialogue.ur: Main arabi seekhna chahta hoon. («an» ke baad: fatha)

dialogue.ar: لَنْ تَصِلَ الرِّسالَةُ اليَوْمَ.
dialogue.tr: lan taṣila r-risālatu l-yawm
dialogue.en: The letter will not arrive today. (after «lan»: fatha)
dialogue.ur: Khat aaj nahin pahunchega. («lan» ke baad: fatha)

dialogue.ar: لَمْ أَعْمَلْ حَتّى الآنَ.
dialogue.tr: lam aʿmal ḥattā l-ān
dialogue.en: I have not worked until now. (after «lam»: sukun)
dialogue.ur: Main ab tak kaam nahin kar saka. («lam» ke baad: sukoon)

dialogue.ar: لا تُسافِرْ غَداً.
dialogue.tr: lā tusāfir ghadan
dialogue.en: Do not travel tomorrow. (after «lā» of prohibition: sukun)
dialogue.ur: Kal safar mat karo. («lā» nahi ke baad: sukoon)

dialogue.ar: يَقْرَأُ مُحَمَّدٌ القُرْآنَ.
dialogue.tr: yaqraʾu Muḥammadun l-qurʾān
dialogue.en: Muhammad reads the Quran. (no particle: damma)
dialogue.ur: Muhammad Quran parhta hai. (koi harf nahin: damma)

dialogue.ar: يَشْرَبُ المَريضُ الدَّواءَ.
dialogue.tr: yashrabu l-marīḍu d-dawāʾ
dialogue.en: The patient drinks the medicine. (no particle: damma)
dialogue.ur: Mareez dawa peeta hai. (koi harf nahin: damma)

dialogue.ar: لا تَحْمِلْ هذا يا وَلَدي.
dialogue.tr: lā taḥmil hādhā yā waladī
dialogue.en: Do not carry this, my son.
dialogue.ur: Beta, yeh mat uthao.

dialogue.ar: لَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلى بِلادٍ غَريبَةٍ عَنْ ثَقافَتي.
dialogue.tr: lan adhhaba ilā bilādin gharībatin ʿan thaqāfatī
dialogue.en: I will never go to lands foreign to my culture.
dialogue.ur: Main apni saqafat se anjaan mulkon mein kabhi nahin jaunga.

dialogue.ar: أُحِبُّ أَنْ تَصْحَبَ أَوْلادَكَ في سَفَرِكَ.
dialogue.tr: uḥibbu an taṣḥaba awlādaka fī safarik
dialogue.en: I like you to take your children with you on your trip.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe pasand hai ke aap safar mein apne bachchon ko saath rakhein.

q.en: After «لَنْ» the present verb ends in:
After «لَمْ» the present verb ends in:

q.ur: «أُريدُ أَنْ أُسافِرَ» ko mana'ee shakl dein:

intro.en: Practise writing short paragraphs about what you learned: old and modern transport, communication, the difference between rich and poor countries, and the second dialogue as a story.
intro.ur: Jo kuch seekha usay chhote paragraph mein likhne ki mashq karein: purani aur jadeed sawariyan, rabta, amir aur ghareeb mumalik ka farq, aur doosri guftagu ko kahani ki shakl mein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ فَقَراتٍ قَصيرَةٍ عَمّا تَعَلَّمْتَ: النَّقْلُ قَديماً وَحَديثاً، وَالاتِّصالُ، وَالفَرْقُ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ الغَنِيَّةِ وَالفَقيرَةِ، وَالحِوارُ الثّاني عَلى شَكْلِ قِصَّةٍ.

options_ar: جُزْءٌ مِنْ نَصٍّ يَضُمُّ جُمَلاً مُتَرابِطَةً

intro.en: Practise the Ruq'a script, a simple and quick everyday handwriting. Notice which letters go below the line and which letters have an empty inside.
intro.ur: Khat-e-ruq'a ki mashq karein, jo roz-marra ki aasaan aur tez likhai hai. Dekhein kaun se harf line ke neeche jaate hain aur kin ke andar khali jagah hoti hai.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى خَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، وَهُوَ خَطٌّ بَسيطٌ وَسَريعٌ لِلْكِتابَةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى الحُروفِ الَّتي تَنْزِلُ تَحْتَ السَّطْرِ وَالحُروفِ المُجَوَّفَةِ.

q.en: What does «اُكْتُبْها» ask you to do?
